nodes.label: Media Library module (ADR-0026)
nodes.rationale: ADR-0026 extracted the media registry from news_portal into a System Foundation module so brochure sites (blog_content + tenant_domain, no news portal) get managed media without needing to enable the news portal preset.

nodes.label: NewsMediaPort (retired, ADR-0026 steps 3-4)
nodes.rationale: Carried isFullOnlineR2ModeActiveForTenant, an editorial question belonging to news_portal, coupling the media port to portal policy; split so media answers 'must reference be registry-based?' and news_portal keeps its own preset.
